entry_effects.text: Infiltrate the Hoodlum hideout. Each accepted step advances all five guards by one patrol cell. Avoid their displayed forward vision and stay away from a guard for two consecutive steps. Use Attack twice from a guard's current rear to neutralize it; doing so near another guard raises the alarm. Reach the far exit at(6,-14,0) or neutralize all five. Guard poses and danger cells update after each step.
